verses.en: These be the words which Moses spake unto all Israel on this side Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain over against the Red sea, between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
verses.sm: Atua O upu nei na fai atu ai Mose ia Isaraelu uma lava i le itu mai o Ioritana, i le vao i le eleele laugatasi e feagai ma Sufe, i le va o Parana, ma Topelu, ma Lapana, ma Haserota, ma Tisaapa.

verses.en: (There are eleven days' journey from Horeb by the way of mount Seir unto Kadesh-barnea.)
verses.sm: O le savaliga mai Horepa i le ala e ui i le mauga o Seira e oo atu i Katesapanea, e sefulu ma le tasi ona aso.

verses.en: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, that Moses spake unto the children of Israel, according unto all that the LORD had given him in commandment unto them;
verses.sm: Ua oo i le tausaga e fagafulu, o le masina e tasi le sefulu ma le tasi, o le aso muamua o lea masina, ona fai atu ai lea o Mose i le fanauga a Isaraelu o mea uma lava na poloai atu ai le ALI ia te ia e fai atu ia i latou;

verses.en: After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites, which dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, which dwelt at Astaroth in Edrei:
verses.sm: ina ua uma ona fasia e ia o Sekono le tupu o sa Amori sa nofo i Hesepona, ma Oko le tupu o Vasana sa nofo i Aserota i Eterei,

verses.en: On this side Jordan, in the land of Moab, began Moses to declare this law, saying,
verses.sm: i le itu mai o Ioritana i le nuu o Moapi na amata ai ona folafolaina e Mose o lenei tulafono, ua faapea atu,

verses.en: The LORD our God spake unto us in Horeb, saying, Ye have dwelt long enough in this mount:
verses.sm: Na fetalai mai le Aw lo tatou Atua ia te i tatou i Horepa, ua faapea mai, Ua leva lo outou nonofo i lenei mauga;

verses.en: Turn you, and take your journey, and go to the mount of the Amorites, and unto all the places nigh thereunto, in the plain, in the hills, and in the vale, and in the south, and by the sea side, to the land of the Canaanites, and unto Lebanon, unto the great river, the river Euphrates.
verses.sm: ia liliu ane outou, ma savavali, ma o atu outou i le mauga o sa Amori, ma mea uma lava e latalata ane i ai, i le eleele laugatasi, ma le mauga, ma le nuu maulalo, ma le itu i toga, ma le matafaga, e oo i le nuu o sa Kanana, ma Lepanona, e oo lava i le vaitafe tele, o le vaitafe o Eufirate.

verses.en: Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give unto them and to their seed after them.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua ou tuuina atu le nuu i o outou luma, o atu ia outou ina fai mo outou le nuu na tauto ai le ALII i o outou tama o Aperaamo, ma Isaako, ma lakopo na te foaiina atu ia te i latou, ma a latou fanau pe a mavae atu i latou.

verses.en: And I spake unto you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you myself alone:
verses.sm: Na ou fai atu foi ia te outou i ia ona po, ua faapea atu, Ou te le lavatia lava outou e a‘u e toatasi;

verses.en: The LORD your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.
verses.sm: ua faatoateleina outou e le ALII lo outou Atua, faauta foi, o le aso nei e pei o fetu o le lagi ona toatele o outou.

verses.en: (The LORD God of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as ye are, and bless you, as he hath promised you!)
verses.sm: la atili faatoateleina outou e le ALII le Atua o outou tama, ia faatoaafeina lo outou faitau, ma ia manuia outou ia te ia, e pei ona fetalai mai o ia ia te outou.

verses.en: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?
verses.sm: Ou te lavatia faapefea e a'u e toatasi o a outou mea mamafa, ma a outou avega, ma a outou fefinauaiga?

verses.en: Take you wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you.
verses.sm: Ia outou filifilia mo outou o tagata popoto o e ua mafaufau, ma e ua iloa, i o outou itu aiga, ina ia ou tofia i latou e fai ma alii ia te outou.

verses.en: And ye answered me, and said, The thing which thou hast spoken is good for us to do.
verses.sm: Na outou tali mai ia te au, ua faa266 pea mai, O le mea lelei lea ua e fai mal ai matou te faia.

verses.en: So I took the chief of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens, and officers among your tribes.
verses.sm: Ona ou ave ai lea o alii sili o outou itu aiga, o tagata popoto i latou, ma e ua iloa, ma ou tofia i latou e fai ma alii ia te outou, o alii o taitoaafe, ma alii o taitoaselau, ma alii o taitoalimagafulu, ma alii o taitoasefulu, ma faipule i o outou itu aiga.

verses.en: And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear the causes between your brethren, and judge righteously between every man and his brother, and the stranger that is with him.
verses.sm: O ona po lava ia na ou poloai atu ai i o outou faamasino, ua faapea atu, Ia outou faalogologo i upu a outou uso, ma ia outou faamasino tonu i le tagata ma lona uso, ma le tagata ese o loo ia te ia.

verses.en: Ye shall not respect persons in judgment; but ye shall hear the small as well as the great; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment is God's: and the cause that is too hard for you, bring it unto me, and I will hear it.
verses.sm: Aua tou te faailogaina se tasi i le faamasinoga; e pei ona outou faalogologo i le tagata nuu ia faapea foi i le alii; aua lava tou te fefefe i tagata, aua o le faamasinoga o i lo outou Atua lea; a o le mea e faigata ia te outou, ia au mai lea ia te au, ou te faalogologo i ai.

verses.en: And I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should do.
verses.sm: O ona po lava ia na ou poloai atu ai ia te outou o mea uma lava tou te faia.

verses.en: And when we departed from Horeb, we went through all that great and terrible wilderness, which ye saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites, as the LORD our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh-barnea.
verses.sm: Na tatou o mai mai Horepa, na tatou savavali foi i lea vao uma e lautele ma le matautia, na outou iloa ai i le ala i le mauga o sa Amori, e pei ona poloai mai ai le ALII lo tatou Atua ia i tatou; ona tatou o atu lea i Katesapanea.

verses.en: And I said unto you, Ye are come unto the mountain of the Amorites, which the LORD our God doth give unto us.
verses.sm: Ona ou fai atu lea ia te outou, Ua outou oo mai lava i le mauga o sa Amori, na foaiina mai ia i tatou e le ALII lo tatou Atua.

verses.en: Behold, the LORD thy God hath set the land before thee: go up and possess it, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath said unto thee; fear not, neither be discouraged.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua tuuiua atu e le ALII lou Atua le nuu i ou luma, ina e alu ae ia, ia fai mou, e pei ona fetalai mai ia te ce o le ALII le Atua o ou tama; aua le fefe, aua le atuatuvale.

verses.en: And ye came near unto me every one of you, and said, We will send men before us, and they shall search us out the land, and bring us word again by what way we must go up, and into what cities we shall come.
verses.sm: Ona outou faalatalata mai lea ia te au o outou uma lava, ua outou fai mai foi, Ia tatou aauina atu tagata e muamua ia i tatou, ina ia latou asiasi le nuu mo i tatou, ma latou au mai ai se tala ia i tatou i se ala tatou te o ae ai, o aai foi tatou te o i ai.

verses.en: And the saying pleased me well: and I took twelve men of you, one of a tribe:
verses.sm: Sa lelei lea upu ia te au, ona ou aauina atu ai lea ni o outou, o tagata e toasefulu ma le toalua, o le itu aiga ma le tagata.

verses.en: And they turned and went up into the mountain, and came unto the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.
verses.sm: Ona latou faasaga ae lea, ma o ae i le mauga, ua latou oo atu i le alia o Esekolo, ua latou asiasi ai.

verses.en: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought it down unto us, and brought us word again, and said, It is a good land which the LORD our God doth give us.
verses.sm: Na tago foi o latou lima i fua o le fanua, ona au mai ai lea ia te i tatou, ma latou foi mai ai ma se tala ia te i tatou, ua latou faapea mai, Ua lelei le nuu ua foaiina mai e le ALII lo tatou Atua ia i tatou.

verses.en: Notwithstanding ye would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God:
verses.sm: Na outou le mafafai ona o ae, a ua outou fouvale i le afioga a le ALII lo outou Atua.

verses.en: And ye murmured in your tents, and said, Because the LORD hated us, he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.
verses.sm: Na outou muimui foi i o outou fale ie, ua outou faapea ane, O le “ino'ino mai o le ALII ia i tatou ua na au mai ai i tatou ai le nuu o Aikupito ina ia tuuina atu i tatou i lima o sa Amori, ia faaumatia ai i tatou.

verses.en: Whither shall we go up? our brethren have discouraged our heart, saying, The people is greater and taller than we; the cities are great and walled up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakims there.
verses.sm: Pe tatou te o ae ifea? ua faavaivai mai E o tatou uso o tatou loto, ua faapea mai, O le nuu e sili ona toatele, ma le maualuluga ia te i tatou; o aai foi ua tetele, ma ua puipui i pa e oo i le lagi, i le ma lea foi, na matou iloa ai atalti o Anaki.

verses.en: Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.
verses.sm: Ona ou fai atu lea ia te outou, Aua tou te fefefe, aua foi tou te matatau ia te i latou.

verses.en: The LORD your God which goeth before you, he shall fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;
verses.sm: O le ALII lo outou Atua o le na te muamua ia te outou, e tau o ia mo outou, e tusa ma mea uma na na faia mo outou i Aikupito i o outou luma;

verses.en: And in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the LORD thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came into this place.
verses.sm: ma le vao foi, na e iloa ai ona tausia oe e le ALII lou Atua, e pei o le tagata ona tausia o lona atalii, i le ala uma na outou savavali ai, ua 00 ina outou oo mai lava i lenei mea.

verses.en: Yet in this thing ye did not believe the LORD your God,
verses.sm: A ua outou le faatuatua i le ALII lo outou Atua i lenei lava mea,

verses.en: Who went in the way before you, to search you out a place to pitch your tents in, in fire by night, to shew you by what way ye should go, and in a cloud by day.
verses.sm: o le na muamua ia te outou i le ala, e saili se mea tou te to lauapi ai, o i le afi ile po, e faaali atu ai ia te outou le ala tou te savavali ai, o i le ao foi ina O ao.

verses.en: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and sware, saying,
verses.sm: Ua faafofogaina mai e le ALII o a outou upu, ona toasa lea o ia, ua tauto foi ia, ua faapea,

verses.en: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers,
verses.sm: E le iloa lava e se toatasi o nei tagata o lenei tupulaga leaga le nuu lelei na ou tauto ai e avatu mo outou tama,

verses.en: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children, because he hath wholly followed the LORD.
verses.sm: na o Kalepo le atalii o Iefune, e iloa ai e ia; ou te avatu foi ia te ia ma ana fanau le nuu na ia alu atu i ai; aua ua matuā mulimuli atu o ia i le ALII.

verses.en: Also the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, Thou also shalt not go in thither.
verses.sm: Ua toasa mai foi le ALII ia te au talu o outou, ua faapea mai, O oe foi, e te le alu i ai.

verses.en: But Joshua the son of Nun, which standeth before thee, he shall go in thither: encourage him: for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
verses.sm: O Iosua le atalii o Nuno, o lé tu i ou luma, e alu lava o ia i ai; ia e faamalosi ia te ia, aua o ia na te tofia le nuu mo Isaraelu.

verses.en: Moreover your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, and your children, which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.
verses.sm: O a outou tama iti foi na outou fai mai ai, e avea i latou ma tagata o taua, ma a outou fanau na le iloa i lea aso se mea lelei po o se mea leaga, latou te oo lava i ai, OU te avatu ai ia te i latou, e fai ai foi mo latou tofi.

verses.en: But as for you, turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
verses.sm: A o outou, ina liliu ane ia outou, ma o atu i le vao, i le ala i le sami Ulaula.

verses.en: Then ye answered and said unto me, We have sinned against the LORD, we will go up and fight, according to all that the LORD our God commanded us. And when ye had girded on every man his weapons of war, ye were ready to go up into the hill.
verses.sm: Ona outou tali mai lea, ua outou faapea mai ia te au, Ua matou agasala atu i le ALII; matou te o ae, matou te sii atu le taua, e pei o mea uma lava na poloai mai ai le ALII lo tatou Atua. Ona laei ai lea o outou, ua taitasi ai ma ana mea tau, ua oso vale foi outou e o ae i le mauga.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto me, Say unto them, Go not up, neither fight; for I am not among you; lest ye be smitten before your enemies.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai mai ai lea o le ALI ia te au, la e fai atu ia te i latou, Aua tou te o ae, aua tou te sii atu le taua, auá o a‘u, Ou te le i ai ia te outou; neʻi fasia outou i luma o e ua ita mai ia te outou.

verses.en: So I spake unto you; and ye would not hear, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD, and went presumptuously up into the hill.
verses.sm: Ona ou fai atu ai lea ia te outou, a ua outou le faalogo mai lava, a ua outou fouvale i le afioga a le ALI, na outou faamaualuga, ma outou o ae i le mauga.

verses.en: And the Amorites, which dwelt in that mountain, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir, even unto Hormah.
verses.sm: Ona o mai ai lea o sa Amori, sa nonofo i lea mauga, e faafetaiai ia te outou, na latou tuliloa foi ia te outou, e pei ona faia e lagomeli, ua latou fafasi ia te outou i Seira e oo atu i Horema.

verses.en: And ye returned and wept before the LORD; but the LORD would not hearken to your voice, nor give ear unto you.
verses.sm: Ona outou toe foi mai lea, ma outou fetagisi i luma o le ALII, a ua le faafofogaina mai e le ALII o a outou upu, ua le liliu mai foi ona fofoga ia te outou.

verses.en: So ye abode in Kadesh many days, according unto the days that ye abode there.
verses.sm: Ona outou nonofo ai lea i Katesa i aso e tele, o ona aso lava na outou nonofo ai
